findings.title: `npm run build` will fail: no @types/node, and the test file is in `include`
findings.why: `tsconfig.json` includes all of `src`, and `src/index.test.ts` imports `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`. The only devDependency is `typescript`, so tsc has no Node type declarations. It reports TS2307 (cannot find module) for those imports, so the new build script exits non-zero. Adding `@types/node` or excluding the test file from the build would fix it.

findings.title: Build output includes the compiled tests, and `node --test` will run them twice
findings.why: The `include` of `src` also compiles `src/index.test.ts` into `dist/index.test.js`. `npm test` runs a bare `node --test`, which discovers `*.test.js` files anywhere outside `node_modules`. After a build it runs both the `src` tests and the `dist` copies. The `.gitignore` entry for `dist` does not stop discovery.

findings.title: The build produces `dist`, but nothing in package.json points to it
findings.why: The README says other projects import this library. package.json has no `main`, `exports`, `types` or `files` field, so even with a working build consumers cannot resolve the compiled entry (`dist/index.js` and `dist/index.d.ts`).
